title: Modal
description: A trigger that opens a modal <dialog>. x-modal is the dialog() behavior (semantics/dialog.js exports it as `modal`): with modal-title or modal-content the host becomes a clickable trigger that builds and opens the dialog; without them the host is hidden and its children become the content of a dialog opened by calling element.open().

modal-title.description: Dialog heading. Its presence (or modal-content's) makes the host a visible trigger that opens the dialog on click. `title` is read first when both are set.

modal-content.description: Dialog body HTML. Its presence (or modal-title's) makes the host a trigger. `content` is read first when both are set.

modal-size.description: Size of the opened dialog. `size` is read first when both are set.

variant.description: Layout of the opened dialog; any value but default adds x-dialog--{{value}} to it.

open.description: Opens the dialog (trigger mode: built from the attributes; definition mode: built from the host's children).

setup: <button x-modal modal-title="Confirm" modal-content="Are you sure?">Open Modal</button>

Defined

Body from children, opened with element.open()
